strings.en: After all I told you... What have you done!
It's too soon to take root! Does Lady Diore know about this!? Abel!
Heh... Earthlings are nothing to fear.
No need to bother with Londo Bell. I'll force total surrender...
Heh heh, though "surrender" just means everything becomes ours...
Abel! Why won't you listen to what he says!?
He once fought against this thing called Dancougar...!
Keim... Aren't you trusting that man a little too much?
Just a man we found while wandering space... He's no Dirad.
Am I wrong, Keim?
Besides, the robots he brings with him...
Some are different from our battle mechs. What are they?
Isn't he the criminal, bringing filthy alien ways to us great Dirad?
...Those are... comrades he fought alongside in the last war, he said...
Nonsense. Don't take his side, Keim.
In any case, Londo Bell is sure to show up as we near Earth...
They'll pay dearly for all the trouble they've caused us... Heh heh.
(Lady Diore seems terribly fond of that man...
What on earth is so special about him...)
Lord Shapiro... Where have you gone? I... I...
Captain... Do you think it can fire?
I don't know... It's fifty-fifty, I'd say.
In the worst case, we'll have to storm the planet's core directly...
Huh? Aren't we settling it with the colony laser?
You're saying the colony laser won't be enough?
When we entered Gryps II...
several of the colony's laser emitters had been destroyed.
No... then the whole plan is a failure...
We did some emergency repairs, but... who knows.
It hasn't been used since the Gryps Conflict, right? Will it be OK...?
Gah, if I'd known, I would've gone to Gryps too...
C'mon, you'd have had no time for that with Aestivalis upkeep anyway.
Either way, I hope it fires... Captain, how's the asteroid moving!?
Faster than expected...! Isn't the colony laser firing yet!?
Heh, so the planet's walking over here on its own...!
Geez... I doubt it's just out for a stroll, though.
A planet out for a stroll... Sounds like something I've heard before.
Time to fire... It's almost here.
C'mon, please...!
Isn't this kinda exciting, Judau?
Well... let's see what happens.
It's time! Everyone, don't let the flash blind you!
Let's go out with a great big boom!!
Huh...!? It's not firing!?
No... great big boom.
So... the emergency repairs weren't enough after all...!
It failed!?
What do we do!? Then...
Captain... what do we do now?
I don't know... It's fifty-fifty, I'd say.
In the worst case, we'll have to storm the planet's core directly...
If only we'd secured the colony laser. Damn it!
The delay in advancing on Gryps II cost us dearly. ...Tch.
...With the laser emitters at the colony's base completely destroyed...
So the whole plan's completely fallen apart...
What do we do...
But we can't just sit on our hands... Captain, how's the asteroid moving!?
Faster than expected...! At this rate...!
Heh, so the planet's walking over here on its own...!
Geez... I doubt it's just out for a stroll, though.
A planet out for a stroll... Sounds like something I've heard before.
Enough with the jokes! What are we gonna do now!?
Calm down, Ashta. ...We probably don't have many options.
Shall we go out with a great big boom?
A big boom?
Somehow...
I think I get what she means.
Whatever the enemy may be... we have no choice but to cut it down.
Easy for you to say... but that's not very realistic, is it?
...No, maybe it's not so far-fetched...
Brother, what do you mean? Even with Kenrou...
I don't mean cutting the planet itself...
That unnatural movement isn't from being pulled by gravity,
nor is it anything like jet propulsion...
You mean somebody somewhere is controlling that planet?
Whether from outside or inside the planet, I can't say, but most likely...
Rom may well be right.
The very way that planet moves defies the physics of this world...
So we'll have to investigate the inside after all.
I see... We can't just stand by and do nothing. Shall we go, everyone?
So we're storming it after all. Shoulda just done that from the start.
That's hindsight talking, Shinobu.
In the end, we always just go with whatever comes out, huh?
I see... a swimsuit contest, then.
Huh?
Whatever comes out... ...Lame, I know...
Th-that's hot...!
I'd love to at least be one of the judges.
You guys...
If it's that, I'm pretty confident!
I met the Gandor Team girls on Earth, and they're pretty... high-level.
Urk...
And if the Dangaioh Team comes back, you might be in trouble.
...They'd be a violation of the regulations.
But doesn't it sound fun? Once we've safely met up with the Gandor Team...
let's do it. How about you, Ruri-Ruri?
I'm a child. ...And anyway, that's not the issue here.
Oh, Captain, speaking of the Gandor Team... do you know how they are?
I tried to contact Kyosuke a little while ago, but I couldn't get through.
You too...?
We've been unable to reach Nergal headquarters ourselves.
...The plant planet seems to emit strong electromagnetic waves.
...Communication is impossible.
So neither side knows what's happening with the other...
No use worrying about it, Captain.
Anyway, if that thing hits Earth, it's all over, right?
Besides... if we can't take back Jaburo, even if we handle this,
we won't be able to keep fighting afterward...
So basically we have to win both, right?
...Right.
(We're counting on you down there... Tetsuya...!)
On the ground and in space... we absolutely can't lose.
Right.
(We'll handle things here... I'm counting on you, Koji...!)
Diondra...
Yes... Lord Gades.
You seem to be struggling... Wiping out those meddlesome Earthlings...
and obtaining that certain thing... You haven't forgotten, have you?
...Yes, my lord. Things seem to be in an uproar around Earth.
Londo Bell is sure to appear...
And when they do, I shall put an end to them!
I've heard that before... Gyandlar has no use for the incompetent...
You understand what that means, don't you...?
...Yes, my lord.
Big Sis Diondra! We're all ready to sortie!
Don't you call me Big Sis!
Devil Saturn, it'll go right this time, won't it!?
You betcha! That cow girl's rarin' to go, too!
Don't make the same mistake as last time, Diondra.
Don't run your mouth when you won't even go to the front lines...!
Rom gave you a sound thrashing at the Heavenly Demon Castle before,
so aren't you just too scared to show your face?
...What!?
Rom...? Would that be... Rom Stol, by any chance...?
So it's you...
Your troubles never end, do they...
Is it finally my turn to step in!?
Will you go...?
I was just getting bored. Heh heh heh heh heh heh.
So we're finally taking on that planet... Sigh...
What's wrong, Tenkawa? You scared?
Yamada! Of course he isn't! Right, Akito...?
What's wrong, Akito?
No... maybe he's right. Maybe I am scared...
B-but why? Sure, it's a dangerous operation, but we've been through...
...I get how Tenkawa feels.
The enemies we've fought so far, whether Zeon or the Jupiter guys,
we at least knew what they were.
Though we only just found out who the Jovian Alliance are.
But this plant planet... and that mystery foe, the Einst series, was it?
We still have no idea what they really are...
And going into the base of an enemy like that...
Well, that planet comes first, anyway...
That planet had a field up that even blocked
scans of its internal structure.
That's right... Unlike before, we'll be fighting on their turf...
But hey! Someday we'd have to hit the base of the guys attacking Earth,
that doesn't change, does it!?
Besides, we've got the Ra Cailum crew too. Nothing to worry about!
Yeah... you're right.
It's my first time storming an enemy base, so maybe I just got nervous.
Uh-huh. In the end, what happens, happens.
Exactly. No matter where we fight, it's dangerous all the same.
The level of danger differs greatly, though.
Ruri-Ruri, no calm retorts at a time like this. N-o-t a-l-l-o-w-e-d.
I see.
So, all pilots, please get ready to storm in!
Everyone else, please stay on alert.
Let's get this nasty business over with fast! Commence the operation!
Chop-chop... pork chop...
Oh... Akito...
Hm? What is it...?
...Um... Good luck out there!
Oh, uh... OK...
Captain, please refrain from personal chatter during operations! Geez...
Ufufu, everyone's so young...
...I've got a bad feeling... What is... this...
(Someone's... watching me...?)
Who's there!? Show yourself!
Whoa! Wh-what is it, Excellen!?
What's wrong? We'll be in the combat zone soon. Don't leave your post.
Oopsie, do excuse me.
...Isn't she just tired?
Are you all right?
Huh? Oh, come on, don't all crowd around me like that.
I was just talking to myself. Besides, everyone's tired.
People already think you're weird, so be careful,
Excellen.
Don't scare us like that. People will think you're even weirder.
What!? Is that how people see me!?
Don't let it bother you. This is a crew of oddballs anyway.
That could be taken as a strength. Don't be discouraged.
Ugh... I can't tell if that helps or not. ...That's not very comforting.
...Oh, right, where's Beauty?
She's off with the other straggler, scouting the Meganoids.
Geez, Banjo, you work people pretty hard too, huh?
Do I? Compared to Londo Bell, I'd say I'm a lot easier on people.
Ahaha, you can say that again!
Hmm, I've got to try harder too...
No, easing everyone's nerves like this before the final battle is quite a feat.
...Sigh. So I don't slip up any more, I'll go wait in the Weiss cockpit...
(But seriously... what is this? I still can't shake that feeling...)
